verdict.rationale: Veo's own docs claim 'extended videos' as a creative control, which directly touches the clip-extension half of the story. The pack gives no detail on how extension works or whether it avoids re-rendering. The multi-turn editing claims (element replacement, perspective changes) describe whole-clip refinement, not regenerating one time segment, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documented mechanics of extending an existing clip, segment-level regeneration of part of a video, confirmation that unchanged footage is not re-rendered, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can extend a clip or regenerate one segment of it without re-rendering the whole video

citations.quote: Introducing Veo 3, our video generation model with expanded creative controls – including native audio and extended videos.
